links.outcome: Clinical accuracy and patient-centered relevance of ophthalmic dialogue responses (LLM-judge rank, expert rank, hallucination rate)
links.effect: LLM evaluations ranked EyeRAG highest (mean 1.61 ± 1.04 internal/1.72 ± 1.18 external); experts assigned a mean rank of 1.0; hallucinations fell to 3.3% vs. 30% baseline
links.quote: Experts assigned a mean rank of 1.0, with hallucinations falling to 3.3% (vs. 30% baseline).
